metadata.purpose: Internal observations and proposed experiments kept separate from customer-review evidence.

parking_available_but_not_promoted_in_pr.note: Management believes available parking is not promoted clearly enough on the Google profile; this is not proven by review data.

owner_review_response_process_needs_impr.note: Internal process observation to be considered alongside the calculated owner-response metrics.

menu_considered_static.note: Management considers the current menu experience static.

favourites_manually_selected.note: The favourites section is selected manually rather than from sales or review-attention data.

favourites_not_regularly_updated.note: Management reports that favourites are not refreshed regularly.

weekly_offers_available.note: No weekly-offer programme is currently reported by management.

food_drink_bundles_available.note: No food-and-drink bundled offers are currently reported by management.

menu_should_influence_customer_choice_mo.note: Management wants the menu to guide customer choice more actively.

dish_video_or_richer_media_test_proposed.note: Test richer dish media or short video before treating it as an established practice.

welcome_process_needs_review.note: Management wants to review the arrival and welcome process.

proactive_menu_guidance_proposed.note: Test proactive menu guidance and measure customer response.

complimentary_welcome_appetizer_or_small.note: Test a small welcome gesture; no benefit is assumed before measurement.

four_week_improvement_plan_requested.note: A measurable four-week plan will be designed later; no targets are set in this analysis round.

period_comparisons_preferred_over_lifeti.note: Management wants period comparisons to supplement lifetime totals.
